# The British Green Witch

> The official companion website for the Modern Witchcraft & Wicca books by Mark Hutchinson. These are books for sale (paperback, Kindle and, for one title, hardcover) on Amazon UK and Amazon US, plus free A4 printables for The British Green Witch's Almanac 2027.

The series is unnumbered. The books stand alone.


## The British Green Witch
- Title: The British Green Witch
- Subtitle: A Hedgerow Year of Herbs, Folklore & Seasonal Magic for the British Isles
- Series: Modern Witchcraft & Wicca
- Author: Mark Hutchinson
- Language: English (British)
- Format: Paperback and Kindle
- Paperback ISBN: 9798166870117
- Book page: https://britishgreenwitch.co.uk/the-british-green-witch.html
- Buy Paperback on Amazon UK: https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B0HPZWHKJY
- Buy Paperback on Amazon US: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HPZWHKJY
- Buy Kindle on Amazon UK: https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B0HPZV78M4
- Buy Kindle on Amazon US: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HPZV78M4
- What it is: A month-by-month hedgerow companion for the British Isles, with plant lore, recipes, rituals and clear safety notes. By Mark Hutchinson.
